Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted a misleading search snippet that stated “Ben Affleck as Benny O’Donnell” and incorporated it into the plan (“prior web results indicate Ben Affleck is listed as Benny O’Donnell”), setting it as the expected outcome without verifying on the IMDb/Wikipedia pages already open. In reality, Ben Affleck played Fred O’Bannion in Dazed and Confused, while Benny O’Donnell was played by Cole Hauser. This unverified, incorrect assumption steered the solution toward the wrong answer.
